title: Copy record links to posted Phys. Invt. Order and Recording headers
summary: Record links attached to physical inventory order and recording headers are now copied to their posted documents, matching the behavior of sales, purchase, and warehouse posting flows.
key_points: Record links (notes and attachments) are preserved when posting physical inventory orders
Copy operations added in InsertPostedHeader and InsertPostedRecordings methods
Links remain inside IsHandled gates so custom subscribers retain full control
Regression test verifies links appear on posted documents after posting
No schema or signature changes; purely additive behavior
